page.description: Rocky Linux editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A community enterprise Linux built from RHEL's sources, with ten-year support per major version. Boot, minimal or full DVD.
pros: Enterprise Linux compatibility without a subscription.
Ten-year support horizon for the 10 series.
Boot, minimal and DVD images from the same build.
The project publishes a CHECKSUM file per release directory.
cons: Conservative package versions, as an enterprise rebuild.
The release date shown is the mirror's file date; the project page was not read here.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Rocky Linux; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One path per image: boot, minimal or DVD, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. The date is the official mirror's file date (2026-05-26).
